CustomField.label: Product Code (External)
CustomField.description: Code of this product in the financial system (Exact item code) when that differs from the Product Code, e.g. an Odoo code such as FMC880NL mapped to Exact item 800.313.0260. Used by the Odoo invoice booking (Svc_OdooExactSync); blank = the Product Code is the Exact item code.
